```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Gratitude is expressed to several nations of Europe for their contributions to united efforts in Iraq, Afghanistan, and elsewhere.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support and sacrifice by those nations in the fight against Islamic terrorism will not be forgotten.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The ongoing reconciliation in Northern Ireland is applauded.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Hope is expressed that the success of reconciliation in Northern Ireland might be replicated in Cyprus.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Greater coordination in economic and security affairs between the United States and the republics of Eastern Europe is urged.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Visa waiver status for Poland is urged.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for placement of NATO troops in Poland is expressed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Respect is affirmed for the people of Russia.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Determination to maintain a friendship with Russia beyond the reach of those who wish to divide is affirmed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Ending terrorism, combating nuclear proliferation, and promoting trade are identified as common imperatives with Russia.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The continuing erosion of personal liberty and fundamental rights under the current officials in the Kremlin is identified as a common problem with Russia.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The policies of current officials in the Kremlin are characterized as repressive at home and reckless abroad.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The policies of current officials in the Kremlin are said to imperil the nations which regained their self-determination upon the collapse of the Soviet Union.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A commitment to meet the return of Russian belligerence with the same resolve that led to the collapse of the Soviet Union is made.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Any territorial change in Eastern Europe imposed by force, in Ukraine, Georgia, or elsewhere, will not be accepted.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A commitment to use all appropriate constitutional measures to bring to justice the practitioners of aggression and assassination is made.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
